name: reelagentic
description: ReelAgentic: your AI reel editor. Claude edits raw videos into Instagram-ready reels on macOS and Windows: cuts pauses and retakes, cleans the voice, auto-grades (LUTs too), word-by-word captions in 50+ languages, text behind you and green-screen cutouts, 56 effects incl. 3D, telestrator and beat-locked kinetic type, HyperFrames overlays, long-video-to-shorts with face/cursor reframing, storyboard approval, -14 LUFS export, cover and post caption.
